verdict.rationale:
Rollbar's docs explicitly describe grouping occurrences into Items (fingerprinting-based aggregation), plus dedicated Custom Fingerprinting Rules for fixing incorrect grouping and Item Merging to combine misgrouped items. This directly matches the story of automated grouping with manual override capability.

missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating grouping accuracy at scale, and detail on the specific fingerprinting algorithm (e.g., stack-trace normalization logic).
